note: Fuzzer-controlled input length selects the stack buffer size and whether the crafted mangled name is passed into Demangle.
The input bytes are copied into a stack buffer and NUL-terminated, preserving the attacker-controlled mangled string for parsing.
The parser reads two bytes from the current cursor without first proving that two bytes remain, violating the safety obligation that the cursor must still reference at least two valid characters.
The vulnerable path dereferences the second byte of the cursor, triggering the out-of-bounds read when the mangled input is too short.
